review_notes.summary: Approved after source-language review of all ten dossiers and precision revisions to the textual evidence in Psalm 22 and the Greek construction in Matthew 16:19.

Approved after historical and archaeological review of all ten dossiers, with precision revisions concerning Roman crucifixion and Philippi, ancient conquest rhetoric, Ahaz's Assyrian policy, and the reconstructed setting of Corinthian gatherings.

Approved after review of Jewish and ecumenical Christian reception across all ten dossiers, with precision additions concerning Jewish readings of Genesis 1, Exodus 3, Joshua 6, and Psalm 22; Oriental Orthodox Christological reception of Philippians 2; and Eastern Orthodox and Jewish-Christian reception of Romans 3.

Approved after review of feminist, womanist, liberation, disability, postcolonial, and trauma-aware perspectives across all ten dossiers, with precision additions concerning anti-Judaism in interpretation of women's speech; Black and womanist readings of Exodus; the unnamed woman in Isaiah; Indigenous, Palestinian Christian, feminist, and womanist readings of Joshua; postcolonial and feminist readings of authority in Matthew; African contextual readings of kenosis; survivor-centered readings of lament; and womanist critique of surrogate atonement imagery.
